findings.mechanism: Read‑modify‑write on wallet balance without SELECT FOR UPDATE or atomic UPDATE leads to lost updates under READ COMMITTED.
findings.remediation: Update wallet.debit to perform an atomic UPDATE ... SET balance = balance - :amount or use SELECT ... FOR UPDATE within a SERIALIZABLE transaction.
findings.arithmetic: Initial balance 100.00, 10 concurrent debits of 10.00 each. Lost‑update causes only one subtraction to be applied: final_balance = 100.00 - 10.00 = 90.00.

findings.mechanism: Transaction kept open while awaiting external network calls (shipping.quote, payments.charge) holds DB locks and connections, causing worker saturation and pool pressure.
findings.remediation: Perform external calls before starting the DB transaction or commit/rollback before awaiting; e.g., obtain shipping quote and payment charge first, then open a transaction to debit wallet and create order.
findings.arithmetic: Each request holds a DB connection for the duration of two external calls (~200 ms each). With 4 workers, 4 concurrent requests keep 4 connections occupied, saturating the pool (default size 5) and blocking other work. Worker saturation = active_requests / workers = 4/4 = 1.0.

prediction.condition: 4 concurrent place_order requests each awaiting shipping.quote and payments.charge (~200 ms each)
